mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM t_user WHERE username=#{username} AND status='active'
SELECT conversation_id, user_id, title FROM ai_conversation WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_conversation WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND deleted=0

SELECT c.conversation_id, c.title, COALESCE((SELECT m.content FROM ai_chat_message m WHERE m.conversation_id=c.conversation_id ORDER BY m.message_id DESC LIMIT 1), '') AS preview, c.last_message_at FROM ai_conversation c WHERE c.user_id=#{userId} AND c.deleted=0 ORDER BY c.last_message_at DESC, c.conversation_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_message (conversation_id, role, content, model, page_context) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{model}, #{pageContext})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_conversation SET last_message_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND deleted=0
UPDATE ai_conversation SET deleted=1 WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted=0
